Question 6

Question 6: Using an appropriate GLM comment on how the customers are rating different accommodations in Paris. Predict the user ratings for different accommodation types in Amsterdam based on the fitted model. Calculate the prediction error and comment on what you observe.
We are looking to fit a GLM to the Paris dataset with user rating as the response variable and accommodations type as the predictor variable.

accom_q6 <- subset(accom, city=="Paris" & rating!='NA')

What model should we use to fit this data?

lm_q6 = lm(rating~accommodation_type+distance+price, weight=rating_reviewcount, data=accom_q6)
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(lm_q6)

summary(lm_q6)

predictions <- predict(lm_q6, newdata = accom_ams)
ams_with_predictions <- cbind(accom_ams, predicted_rating = predictions)

ams_with_predictions
ggplot(ams_with_predictions) +
  geom_point(aes(x = rating, y = predicted_rating, colour = accommodation_type)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0) +
  xlim(0, 5) +
  ylim(0, 5) + xlab("Observed User Rating") + ylab("Predicted User Rating") + ggtitle("Observed vs Predicted User Ratings") + labs(colour = "Accommodation Type")

ams_with_predictions %>%
  group_by(accommodation_type) %>%
  filter(!is.na(rating)) %>%
  summarise(average_predicted = mean(predicted_rating), average_rating = mean(rating))

All fairly similar expect guest houses. not much data in guest houses. lots of data for hotels. Prediction Error:

amsterdam_with_predictions_error <- ams_with_predictions %>%
  filter(!is.na(rating)) %>%
  group_by(accommodation_type) %>%
  summarise(error = mean(rating - predicted_rating)^2)

amsterdam_with_predictions_error
